en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a hilly coastal city and harbor with many small buildings and ships. The caption identifies the scene as a view toward Egersheld in Vladivostok. The reverse bears Russian pre‑reform Cyrillic text alongside French "Carte Postale," a Red Cross emblem of the St. Eugenia community, address lines, and a box for the stamp.
